files.manual_review: Technical provenance, source hashes and pending integration decisions; public repository owner/bot/plugin metadata only.

UI model/controller; operation keys generated at runtime, not credentials. No literal identity/session proof or grading key.
Build-mode gate and closed integration screen; no endpoint or credential.
CSS only; no imports, external URL, credential or data payload.

classification_notes: Namuna / O‘quvchi and the Aziz / Karimov placeholders are authored synthetic examples, not fetched student records.
Four physics prompts, sample-* IDs and 6,00/8,00/75,00 are UI fixtures; no correct-option map or scoring engine. Tests assert saved selections, not correctness.
GitHub owner/repository links, public bot username, plugin identifier and pinned source hashes remain as public technical provenance. They are not student records or access credentials.
No .env, credential file, real initData, opaque/refresh token, answer-key file, browser profile, network capture, screenshot or source archive from the laboratory is included.
Absence findings are bounded local review, not a guarantee against all possible secrets or a publication approval.
